title: Check the status of a specific system service
summary: Use systemctl status to see if a service is running, stopped, or failed, and view its recent logs.

steps.explain: Display the current status and recent logs for a specific systemd unit.

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the service or unit (e.g., ssh, nginx, bluetooth)

placeholders.name: TYPE
placeholders.description: The type of unit. Common types are service, timer, socket, target.

steps.expect: Output showing whether the unit is active (running), inactive, or failed, along with recent log lines.
